label: TP
reason: User input from HttpServletRequest flows directly into the format string argument of response.getWriter().format(bar, obj). The variable 'bar' is derived from user input via substring which removes only the last character, leaving potentially malicious content intact. This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary characters including XSS payloads like '<script>' into the HTML response.

evidence.note: User parameter extracted and passed to doSomething where it is truncated by one char then returned.
Truncated user input used as first argument to format(), creating tainted format string vulnerable to XSS.
